request.query: weighted sum absorption using positive real power product sublinear exponent

items.name: ENNReal.rpow_arith_mean_le_arith_mean2_rpow
items.type: ∀ (w₁ w₂ z₁ z₂ : ENNReal), w₁ + w₂ = 1 → ∀ {p : ℝ}, 1 ≤ p → (w₁ * z₁ + w₂ * z₂) ^ p ≤ w₁ * z₁ ^ p + w₂ * z₂ ^ p

items.name: Real.pow_arith_mean_le_arith_mean_pow
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u} (s : Finset ι) (w z : ι → ℝ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) →
    ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 1 → (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ z i) → ∀ (n : ℕ), (∑ i ∈ s, w i * z i) ^ n ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, w i * z i ^ n

items.name: ENNReal.rpow_arith_mean_le_arith_mean_rpow
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u} (s : Finset ι) (w z : ι → ENNReal),
  ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 1 → ∀ {p : ℝ}, 1 ≤ p → (∑ i ∈ s, w i * z i) ^ p ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, w i * z i ^ p

items.name: Real.rpow_of_add_eq
items.type: ∀ {w x y z : ℝ}, 0 ≤ x → w ≠ 0 → y + z = w → x ^ w = x ^ y * x ^ z

items.name: NNReal.rpow_arith_mean_le_arith_mean2_rpow

items.name: NNReal.arith_mean_le_rpow_mean
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u} (s : Finset ι) (w z : ι → NNReal),
  ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 1 → ∀ {p : ℝ}, 1 ≤ p → ∑ i ∈ s, w i * z i ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, w i * z i ^ p) ^ (1 / p)

items.name: NNReal.geom_mean_le_arith_mean_weighted
items.type: ∀ {ι : Type u} (s : Finset ι) (w z : ι → NNReal), ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 1 → ∏ i ∈ s, z i ^ ↑(w i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, w i * z i
